title: State the bare-run agent precedence in the help surface and the herding knowledge area
action: Make the two reader-facing surfaces state what hba-1 shipped. (1) `packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/generated/registry_payload.json` is edited by hand — no live subcommand regenerates it (recorded on cell awm-1); update the `herding run` command description and its `agent` parameter description so the resolution order reads: `--agent <name>`, then the `models.<runtime>.generation` tier slot when it is `{kind:"herding", agent:"<name>"}`, then `herding.agent_command`, then the built-in default. Keep the existing wording style and touch no other command entry. If a registry pin test fails, follow the fix its message names rather than reverting the text. Ask the CLI for the write target and frontmatter (`bee knowledge check`, `bee knowledge context`) rather than assuming this file is the only right home; if the precedence deserves its own concept under bee-herding, promote one and record the deviation. Cite herding-bare-agent D1-D5. SEQUENCING: start only after hba-1 is capped, so the docs describe live behavior.
